description: This file defines an Android Content Provider (`RssContentProvider`) for RSS feed items, including database helper classes, URI matching, and CRUD operation implementations.

classes.name: RssContentProvider
classes.description: An Android Content Provider that manages RSS feed items stored in a SQLite database, supporting CRUD operations and URI matching.

classes.name: DatabaseHelper
classes.description: A static inner class extending ContentProviderDatabaseHelper for creating and upgrading the RSS items database.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the database connection when the content provider is created.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for the given URI (list or single item).

methods.name: query
methods.description: Performs a database query and returns a Cursor over the result set.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates records in the database based on URI and ContentValues.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new RSS item into the database and returns its URI.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a record from the database based on the URI.
